PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.

5. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

6. A — Ice melting to water

7. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.

10. D — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
